function.name: advanced_matrix_ops
function.description: Performs advanced matrix operations with optional caching. Validates that the matrix is a non-empty square numeric matrix. If caching is enabled, caches the result using a provided key or an implicit key.

matrix.description: A non-empty square numeric matrix represented as an array of arrays of numbers.

items.description: A numeric value in the matrix.

use_cache.description: Flag to indicate whether to use (and populate) the result cache for this computation.

cache_key.description: Custom cache key for storing or retrieving the matrix operation result.
